Outcome

Present the replacement as the only current architecture.

Acceptance

- Reader-first predictive and relational examples begin with data shape, estimand, design, frame, and output.
- Advanced operator and sufficient-statistic paths follow the same vocabulary.
- No current page teaches legacy types or compatibility conversion.
- Examples compile on JVM and Scala.js where supported.
set.title: P6.6: rewrite public documentation around the two-kernel unified workflow
